inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required: One staff member needs two complete two more hours in this section in order to meet the annual training hours for this section.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Parents rights needs to be provided to the parents of all children enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: Signed safe sleep policies need to be provided to parents for infants that are 12 months and younger.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Documentation of a fire drill practiced for this month and no documentation that fire extinguishers and carbon monoxide detector is being tested monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: Support of inclusive service information needs to be added to operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The operation doesn't have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: It was observed during the walk through of the inside and outside of the facility that hoses weren't stored properly on the playgrounds, chipping paint and uncovered outlets in classrooms for children younger than five years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the information provided during the investigation, a caregiver did not hold or comfort an infant after placing the child in a bouncer, despite the infant crying and exhibiting signs of distress.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §746.2401(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the evidence provided during the investigation, an infant's hands weren't washed prior to eating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink (26 TAC §746.3421(b))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition - Children encouraged but not forced to eat: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the evidence provided, a caregiver placed a hand on the infant's forehead to prevent the infant from turning his head away and inserted a bite of baby food into the infant's mouth despite the infant's refusal of the baby food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition - Children encouraged but not forced to eat (26 TAC §746.3311(c))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing Before Feeding a Child: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on information provided during the investigation, a caregiver didn't wash her hand before providing food to and infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing Before Feeding a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based in the information provided during the investigation, a caregiver failed to properly use a restrictive device when an infant was allowed to sit in the restrictive without being fastened in with the safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: 1 child needs a physician's signature for their FARE form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Renewal background checks submitted - When you become aware that subject has had a change in state of residence: A staff member in direct contact with children didn't have an active background.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Renewal background checks submitted - When you become aware that subject has had a change in state of residence (26 TAC §745.621(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: 1 child needs an vision/hearing screening for file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Reporting of employees that have left the operation wasn't reported to Licensing by the required deadline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: It was observed during today's inspection that a child was placed in a high chair without washing the child's hands before being given a snack.  The child' was taken out of the chair and hands washed.  It was observed that a child's hands were washed after a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: It was observed that a caregiver didn't wash two infants' hands after a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed: It was observed that a caregiver didn't wash their hands have diaper changing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed (26 TAC §746.3505(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the information received a caregiver yelled at a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Breastfeeding Provisions: Information needs to be added in the operational policies/parent handbook regarding provisions for breastfeeding mothers, and their right to breastfeed or provide breast milk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Breastfeeding Provisions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(25))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 10 child reocrds were reiviewed during inspection.  1 child needs an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan was reviewed during inspection.   How children will be evacuated or relocated to the designated safe area or alternate shelter,  who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments needs to be added to the plan, as well  as how staff will continue to care for the children until each child has been released, and how children will be reunified with parents after  evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted needs to be added to the plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 10 child files were reviwed during inspection.  2 child files need emergency contact addresses.  1 child needs emergency contact information to bee added to enrollment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: Information on preventing  and responding to abuse and neglect needs to be included in the operational policies/parent handbook to include the following:    (A)Required annual training for employees    (B)Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect, including warning signs that a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect and factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect     (C)Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques for child abuse and neglect     (D) Strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations; and    (E)Actions that the parent of a child who is a victim of abuse or neglect should take to obtain assistance and intervention, including procedures for reporting child abuse or neglect
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: 10 child files were reviwed during today's inspection. 1 child file requires a vision and hearing screening for file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))
